verdict.rationale: Claude's own docs show it can create Excel, PowerPoint, Word and PDF files from natural-language prompts and let you download them; Artifacts and Cowork add formatted documents and other content. The iterative-editing half of the story is only implied by the article title and is never described in the quoted text, so coverage is incomplete. missing for 10: explicit documentation of iteratively revising an existing generated file across turns, independent or hands-on corroboration of file creation/editing quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have the assistant create and iteratively edit documents, presentations, and other files I can export

citations.quote: Prompt Claude using natural language to generate Excel spreadsheets, PowerPoint presentations, Word documents, and PDF files that you can download and use immediately.
produce reports with charts and visualizations, and generate presentations from your documents—all without specialized software skills
Common examples of artifact content include: - Documents (Markdown or plain text)
With Cowork, you can describe an outcome, step away, and come back to finished work—formatted documents, organized files, synthesized research, and more.
